claims.sentence: You must complete your selection for optional and elective courses before the semester in which they will be taught begins
You must select optional courses in the semester that precedes the semester in which they will be implemented
You register for them through your student account before the start of the semester in which you will study them, according to the academic calendar
The University sets the specific deadlines for this selection and communicates them through the electronic information and educational environment and corporate email

You may change your list of selected optional courses or withdraw from them before the start of the study period, but all changes require approval from the College considering the objective feasibility of organizing the educational process
You cannot make changes to your planned optional courses after the study begins according to the schedule
You register for elective courses through your student account before the start of the semester in which you will study them, according to the academic calendar
The College sets the specific deadlines for this registration and communicates them through the electronic information and educational environment and corporate email
You cannot make changes to your planned elective courses after the study begins according to the schedule
The evidence does not specify the exact dates or weeks for the selection deadlines, only that they are set by the University for optional courses and by the College for elective courses
The evidence does not state whether you can select optional and elective courses simultaneously or if they follow separate timelines beyond the preceding semester rule for optional courses
The evidence does not define what constitutes the "start of the study period" or how the schedule determines the exact cutoff for changes
The evidence does not provide details on the approval process or criteria the College uses for optional course changes
The evidence does not mention any course pages or alternative procedures that might differ from these regulations
